comment: Professor Shulleeta is a really great professor. He's funny and has a lot of experience in journalism that he uses to make the lectures super interesting. There are 4 quizzes during the semester and 1 project at the end of the year. He grades the presentation more harshly but the quizzes are very doable if you just attend class. Would recommend!
Professor Shulleeta made classes so much fun. He is a really funny guy and makes everyone smile. His class was fairly easy and he truly cares about everyones education.
